composition: Brick and glass pumping hall and free-standing chimneys from the dike · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Gemaal Wortman at Lelystad is the functionalist pumping station of 1956, a brick and glass machine hall with a low gabled roof and flat-roofed side blocks. Cross-shaped chimney columns stand free of the walls. It is overcast, about 14.7°C, with wind near 6.1 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The interior is closed. No exhaust plume is shown. The relief on the wall is not the subject. It is not a windmill and not the lock complex at the Houtribdijk.
